categories.description: Filter listings by Acquire category. Matches the listing's `Category` field (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all categories.
categories.title: Categories

connectedMetrics.description: When checked, only return listings whose SSR summary shows connected analytics (e.g. Google Analytics, Stripe).
connectedMetrics.title: Connected Metrics Only

customers.description: Only return listings whose `Customers` count is >= this value. Parsed from the SSR summary (e.g. '1.2K' -> 1200).
customers.title: Min Customers

hideUnderOffer.description: When checked, skip listings whose status is `Under Offer`.
hideUnderOffer.title: Hide Under-Offer Listings

locations.description: Optional country / region substrings to match against the listing's location field (case-insensitive).
locations.title: Locations

maxAge.description: Only return listings where the business is at most this many years old.
maxAge.title: Max Business Age (years)

maxAnnualGrowthRate.description: Only return listings whose annual growth rate percentage is <= this value.
maxAnnualGrowthRate.title: Max Annual Growth Rate (%)

maxAnnualRecurringRevenue.description: Only return listings with annual revenue <= this value.
maxAnnualRecurringRevenue.title: Max Annual Revenue (USD)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Only return listings with asking price <= this value.
maxPrice.title: Max Asking Price (USD)

maxProfitMultiple.description: Only return listings where askingPrice / annualProfit <= this value.
maxProfitMultiple.title: Max Profit Multiple

maxRevenueMultiple.description: Only return listings where askingPrice / annualRevenue <= this value.
maxRevenueMultiple.title: Max Revenue Multiple

minAge.description: Only return listings where the business is at least this many years old (derived from the Founded / Date Founded field).
minAge.title: Min Business Age (years)

minAnnualGrowthRate.description: Only return listings whose annual growth rate percentage is >= this value. Parsed from the SSR `Growth Rate` / `Annual Growth` field when present.
minAnnualGrowthRate.title: Min Annual Growth Rate (%)

minAnnualRecurringRevenue.description: Only return listings with annual revenue >= this value.
minAnnualRecurringRevenue.title: Min Annual Revenue (USD)

minPrice.description: Only return listings with asking price >= this value.
minPrice.title: Min Asking Price (USD)

minProfitMultiple.description: Only return listings where askingPrice / annualProfit >= this value.
minProfitMultiple.title: Min Profit Multiple

minRevenueMultiple.description: Only return listings where askingPrice / annualRevenue >= this value.
minRevenueMultiple.title: Min Revenue Multiple

minTTMGrossRevenue.description: Trailing-twelve-month gross revenue minimum. Applied against the listing's annual revenue when TTM-specific data isn't exposed on the public SSR page.
minTTMGrossRevenue.title: Min TTM Gross Revenue (USD)

minTTMNetProfit.description: Trailing-twelve-month net profit minimum. Applied against the listing's annual profit when TTM-specific data isn't exposed on the public SSR page.
minTTMNetProfit.title: Min TTM Net Profit (USD)

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential US recommended for reliable SSR fetches; datacenter often works too.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

recastFinancials.description: When checked, only return listings whose SSR `Financials` section indicates seller-recast financials.
recastFinancials.title: Recast Financials Only

sortBy.description: How listings from the public sitemap are traversed. `newest`/`oldest` use the sitemap `lastmod`; `price-low`/`price-high` sort after filtering.
sortBy.title: Sort Order

underAdvisory.description: When checked, only return listings the SSR flags as being under Acquire advisory support.
underAdvisory.title: Under Advisory Only

urls.description: Direct Acquire.com listing URLs. Accepts canonical /startup/<slug> (preferred, public SSR pages) or app /startups/<id> URLs. When provided, overrides category / filter search.
urls.title: Direct Listing URLs (optional)

verifiedBusiness.description: When checked, only return listings Acquire flags as verified.
verifiedBusiness.title: Verified Only
